---
title: "ہائے شامِ غریباں کو زینبؑ نے کہا رو کے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Salam"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Haey sham e ghariban ko Zainab ne kaha ro ke – may ujarr gayi Ghazi
Mera bhai bhi mara gaya aur sar pe meray maa ki – chadar na rahi Ghazi

1
Maqtal may parri lashain hay khof zada manzar
Darya se chalay aao masoom yateemo ko - hay pyas lagi Ghazi

2
Lashon may kharri ho ke baba ko bulati hay
Kano se lahoo jari aur dar ki shiddat se - ye so na saki Ghazi

3
Akhtar kaha Zainab ne ro ro ke Khuda hafiz
Tu jis ka nigehban tha chadar na rahi sar pe – may Shaam chali Ghazi

from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import check_output
p = 'src/data/lyrics/haye-sham-ghriban-ko-zainab-ne-kha-ro-ke.md'
original = check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---\\n', 2)[2].strip()
_, header, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert roman == original
blocks = body.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in blocks] == [2, 3, 3, 3]
assert [b.splitlines()[0] for b in blocks[1:]] == list('۱۲۳')
print('Roman wording unchanged. Urdu preamble and all three stanzas align.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all eight verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the two-line preamble and three numbered stanzas align. Set right-to-left direction, added the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`.

Read “dar” as ڈر (fear) and retained the original “meray maa ki” wording as میرے ماں کی.
